newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 17.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 17.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Thursday even as storms raged in the Pacific and Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.

Tropical Storm Danny was located about 330 miles (528 km) east-northeast of Matamoros, Tamaulipas state, with winds at 45 to 55 knots (50 miles/86 km to 61 miles/105 km per hour). It was moving northeast at three knots (4 miles/6 km per hour).

Felicia, upgraded to hurricane from tropical storm, was spotted 713 miles (1141 km) southwest of Cabo San Lucas, Baja California. The hurricane was sending winds of 65 to 80 knots (71 miles/124 km to 88 miles/152 km per hour.
Hurricane Felicia was not expected to damage Mexico's Pacific coast, the ministry said.
Moderate to strong rains were reported along Mexico's western coastline, with electrical storms in Sinaloa state.
